1. (Currently amended): A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain __that is not accessible without the radially expanded working channel__.

2. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a surgical intervention__.

3. (Original): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __such that the tissue layers are radially displaced and maintained in a separated state by the radially expanded device__.

6. (Original): The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain.

7. (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __by maintaining radial pressure__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __that requires the maintained separation of the tissue__.

8. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a surgical intervention requiring the working channel__.

9. (Original): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

10. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that the tissue layers are radially displaced and maintained in a separated state by the radially expanded device__.

11. (Original): The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue.

12. (Original): The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.

13. (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent __while maintaining the stent in an expanded state__; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __that requires access through the stent-reinforced channel__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

14. (Currently amended): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a surgical intervention requiring the stent-reinforced channel__.

15. (Original): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

16. (Currently amended): The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that the tissue layers are radially displaced and maintained in a separated state by the radially expanded second expandable body__.

17. (Original): The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
